currentRoundInspection.scope: Independent Altazimuth Pavilion: circular red-brick body with white sash lights, pale ribbed dome and roof-skirt circular windows, two projecting north/south portals with terracotta columns and entablatures, ornate northern shaped gable and simpler curved southern gable, small cage finial and schematic static comet vane. Preserve every other Observatory member and the separately mapped planetarium. Exterior only; no optics, furnished rooms, operating dome, copied lettering or inscriptions.
